It's immensely heavy for a Hylian, but a Lynel can cleave through rock with a single swing.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 20 |durability = 35 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Mighty Lynel Spear}} Mighty Lynel Spears are [[Weapon]]s used by [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s found throughout [[Hyrule Kingdom]]. In [[Master Mode]], though, they are used by [[White-Maned Lynel]]s. Both the weight and cutting edge of these Spears have been enhanced by [[Lynel]]s. They belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by [[Lynel]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} Though they are heavy for a [[Hylian]], Lynels are strong enough to cleave through rocks with them. Due to their metallic nature, Mighty Lynel Spears will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] is able to pick them up. They are unable to burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_017" |Life = 35 |Power = 20 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 7 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 16 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 45 |BuyingPrice = 90 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * Mighty Lynel Spears are one of several [[Permanently Missable Items]] in {{BotW|-}}.
